analysis_scope: Contextual exact arithmetic only. Does not certify source correctness, HMACs, selected sets or overall economic qualification.

arithmetic.additions: 100-digit base-10 arithmetic preserves the observed finite clock values; numeric outputs are decimal strings
arithmetic.input: Stored JSON numeric decimals parsed exactly with Decimal
arithmetic.ratios: 50-digit decimal division; display rounding is separate
arithmetic.statistics: Median/min/max of actual sequence sums and per-sequence ratios, never sums of phase medians
arithmetic.uncertainty: Observed same-host ranges only, no new confidence intervals or asymptotic claim; clock and live CPU tick precision remain limited

raw.scope: Separate full authenticated replay, excluded from primary lifetime components.

cold_replay.scope: Cold setup and close components have independent snapshot/index checks between them; this is not uninterrupted cold elapsed. Baseline is authenticated prior evidence, while accepted revisions are genuinely replayed. No full cold CPU/close CPU is recorded.

residuals.scope: Continuous outer residuals cannot isolate constructor or supported close; start is same-arm observed ready.wall. Do not substitute timings from the separate interleaved arm.

work.byte_scope: Export bytes are logical bytes written to sealed memfd and hashed by materialization, not total physical memory traffic. Promotion reads the successor again inside persistence. Zero full-export disk writes excludes memfd movement, baseline IO and small durable objects.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.close_scope: Supported adapter close terminates/waits daemons and removes private files; no Rust EOF/destructor guarantee.
raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.

raw.scope: Separate full authenticated replay, excluded from primary lifetime components.

cold_replay.scope: Cold setup and close components have independent snapshot/index checks between them; this is not uninterrupted cold elapsed. Baseline is authenticated prior evidence, while accepted revisions are genuinely replayed. No full cold CPU/close CPU is recorded.

residuals.scope: Continuous outer residuals cannot isolate constructor or supported close; start is same-arm observed ready.wall. Do not substitute timings from the separate interleaved arm.

work.byte_scope: Export bytes are logical bytes written to sealed memfd and hashed by materialization, not total physical memory traffic. Promotion reads the successor again inside persistence. Zero full-export disk writes excludes memfd movement, baseline IO and small durable objects.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.close_scope: Supported adapter close terminates/waits daemons and removes private files; no Rust EOF/destructor guarantee.
raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.

work.byte_scope: Export bytes are logical bytes written to sealed memfd and hashed by materialization, not total physical memory traffic. Promotion reads the successor again inside persistence. Zero full-export disk writes excludes memfd movement, baseline IO and small durable objects.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.close_scope: Supported adapter close terminates/waits daemons and removes private files; no Rust EOF/destructor guarantee.
raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.

work.byte_scope: Export bytes are logical bytes written to sealed memfd and hashed by materialization, not total physical memory traffic. Promotion reads the successor again inside persistence. Zero full-export disk writes excludes memfd movement, baseline IO and small durable objects.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.close_scope: Supported adapter close terminates/waits daemons and removes private files; no Rust EOF/destructor guarantee.
raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.

work.byte_scope: Export bytes are logical bytes written to sealed memfd and hashed by materialization, not total physical memory traffic. Promotion reads the successor again inside persistence. Zero full-export disk writes excludes memfd movement, baseline IO and small durable objects.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.close_scope: Supported adapter close terminates/waits daemons and removes private files; no Rust EOF/destructor guarantee.
raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.

residuals.scope: Continuous outer residuals cannot isolate constructor or supported close; start is same-arm observed ready.wall. Do not substitute timings from the separate interleaved arm.

work.byte_scope: Export bytes are logical bytes written to sealed memfd and hashed by materialization, not total physical memory traffic. Promotion reads the successor again inside persistence. Zero full-export disk writes excludes memfd movement, baseline IO and small durable objects.

memory.scope: Interleaved post-phase per-process observations only; VmHWM is cumulative including startup. Adapter includes references/report history and prior oracles. No sum across processes, aggregate peak, continuous-arm memory measurement or phase-peak claim.

native_identity_observations.scope: Interleaved arm only. Native finish includes all-component root advancement/full-index cloning, but excludes sparse-patch comparison/serialization/transport and Python reconstruction.

raw_components.close_scope: Supported adapter close terminates/waits daemons and removes private files; no Rust EOF/destructor guarantee.
raw_components.scope: Observed constructor/start + every production apply + supported close API intervals; intervening independent oracles and harness evidence packaging are excluded. Direct comparator is a fresh full Rust command at genesis and every exact accepted revision.

raw_cpu_components.scope: Adapter + completed-child resource CPU + live producer/index/kernel procfs CPU; SC_CLK_TCK granularity applies to live daemons. Separately summed observed API intervals; direct full Rust uses completed-child CPU per actual fresh command.
